_comment: Template: copy to <lang>.json (e.g. hi.json, ar.json, ko.json) and translate the values. Keys you omit fall back to English, so a partial file is fine. Drop it in ~/.immurok/localization/ to override the bundled pack.

unpair.done.local.only: This Mac's link data was cleared. The device was not connected, so its slot is still occupied — unlink again once it reconnects, otherwise linking again will fail.
unpair.done.message: This Mac's link data has been cleared.
unpair.failed.wrong_slot: The device did not unlink — its active slot isn't this Mac's (it may be parked on the other host, or on an empty slot). Switch it back to this Mac on the device (press the switch fingerprint), then unlink again. This Mac's link data was left unchanged.
unpair.message:
This removes the link between this Mac and the device: the device clears this Mac's host slot, and the link key and lock-screen password stored on this Mac are deleted.

Fingerprints on the device and the other host's link are not affected.
unpair.message.lastslot: This is the last host linked to the device. After unlinking, the device knows no computer at all while its fingerprints remain — linking again is then impossible without a factory reset, which also destroys every SSH private key stored on the device. To move to a different computer, link the new one first, then come back and unlink this one.
unpair.title: Unlink
